dsh-msg-rewind 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。对话回退：/undo 回退一轮，/rewind 回退到历史消息，悬浮用户气泡可可视化撤回。

posts.en:
dsh-msg-rewind is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Conversation rewind for dsh web: /undo rolls back one turn, /rewind cuts to a past message, and hovering a user bubble offers a visual undo.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9269fbd7fefc4b69cb23.html
